title: Lanework lane
description: A lane's `index.md` — depth 1 inside a board. Level is position; `kind` states it anyway.

schema.description: Always 1. Below the board root a missing value reads as 1.

title.description: The lane's display name. Absent shows the untitled placeholder.

kind.description: `lane`. Written at creation; the only discriminator inside `.trash/`.

created.description: When the lane was filed, and by whom.

modified.description: The last app write that rewrote this file's content.

icon.description: The lane's SF Symbol and the tint it wears.

order.description: Rank among lanes, ascending left-to-right. Missing or unusable reads as append-at-end.

width.description: Width multiplier, 1 or more (default 1), no cap. A reading below 1 reads as 1.

collapsed.description: Folds the lane to a slim strip. Absent is expanded, and the app removes the key rather than writing false.

presentation.description: How the lane draws its cards: `list` for one-line rows, `card` (the default, absent) for faces. A name this version does not draw reads as cards and keeps its bytes. The app removes the key rather than writing `card`.

group.description: How the lane's cards are sectioned on screen. Presentation-only: nothing writes the datapoint a lane groups by.

group-by.description: Retired: read only where `group` is absent or null, and folded into `group` on the lane's next write. Write `group`.

filter.description: Which of the lane's cards show. AND across clauses; presentation-only, a filtered-out card is never touched.

labels.description: The labels a fresh card born into this lane starts with: bare names (free labels) or label entries of the board's own kinds, unioned into its own.

card-defaults.description: What a fresh card born into this lane starts with. Applied at the mint, never on arrival.

background.description: Reserved (owner ruling 2026-11-09): neither read nor written. A lane carrying it keeps its bytes.

locked.description: What the app's own editing may not change in this lane: `content` (title, body, attachments, relations) and `comments` (the thread). A name this version does not know is kept as written and ignored; `move` is reserved. Binds the app only; files are not policed.

iconColor.description: Retired: folded into `icon.color` on the next icon-touching write. The mapping wins per property.

modified-by.description: Retired: folds into `modified.by`. The map wins where both are present.

author.description: Reserved: never written. Folds into `created.by` as `{name: …}` by a scheduled heal at every level.

deleted.description: Retired: the tombstone model. Deletion is a move into `.trash/`; a lane carrying it loads live, the key ignored and logged.
